Ivy: Heads-up 10am EBR for Solstice on Wednesday. Need final slide deck, a 1-pager exec ask, and a short list of renewal risks. Opening thread for owners.

Marcus: I'll handle the renewal risk heatmap + one-line recommendation. Noting usage dip in search API and two major accounts at risk.

Leah: I'll update onboarding timeline and capture training attendance. Current blocker: missing completion for integrator team. Adding a slide.

Ben: I'll pull the CS metrics and the customer quote. Also will snapshot error-rate trend and add to the risk slide.

Ivy: Can we make exec ask very tactical: 1) approve discounted uplift for critical orgs, 2) approve SWAT for integrator onboarding. One sentence each.

Marcus: Agreed. Suggest owners: Leah for onboarding remediation plan, Ben for metrics + quote, Marcus for risk + outreach plan, Ivy for final deck + rehearsals.

Leah: Accepted. ETA EOD for slide updates.

Ben: Uploaded metrics screenshot to slide 3 and a short quote. Deck v1: https://drive.redwood/s/qbr/solstice_v1 (check perms).

ops-bot: REMINDER: runbook must include weekend escalation contact and post-EBR follow-up owner.

Ivy: Added weekend contact (@Marcus) and follow-up owner (@Leah) in runbook. Scheduling a 20min rehearsal 45min before the meeting.

Marcus: I'll prep the outreach template for at-risk accounts and bring it to rehearsal.

Ivy: Thanks everyone 70b; will post rehearsal invite and compile final action rollup after practice.
